method: Direct source-based Blender modeling from the original Bulbasaur sprite. Generated reference unavailable. Tailored continuous skin, custom quadruped deform rig, geometric bulb lobes, embedded skin normal and roughness textures, vertex-color source patches.
visualReview: Inspected actual GLB reimport front, back, Tackle anticipation/strike, hit, Growl and faint poses. Recognizable source-inspired silhouette and coherent connected anatomy. Faint no longer intersects the floor. No detached or exploded geometry visible in inspected frames.
limitations: Visual style remains stylized PBR, not hyperreal.

Residual inner-foot surface motion peaks at 0.0611 model units (4.4 percent of height); claw contact is more stable. v1 remains usable for prototype demonstration but contact is not production accepted.
Growl uses head, neck and body motion without a jaw-open morph.
Faint is a lowered exhausted pose, not a full collapse.
These asset renders do not certify the runtime camera or source-event timing.
independentRuntimeReview: Integration owner verifies actual battle playback separately.
